map.→ 打开消费者退一赔三计算器工具: -> Open the consumer triple-refund calculator tool
map.买到假冒伪劣商品，按《消费者权益保护法》第 55 条计算「退一赔三」的赔偿金额。: Calculate the compensation for a "three times the price, or triple refund" claim on counterfeit or substandard goods under Article 55 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law.
map.价款三倍不足 500 元的，按 500 元保底赔偿。: If three times the price is below 500 CNY, compensation is floored at 500 CNY.
map.债务/欠款诉讼时效计算器: Statute of limitations calculator for debts and arrears
map.普通消费欺诈适用消法「退一赔三、保底 500」；食品领域明知不符合安全标准仍经营: Ordinary consumer fraud falls under the Consumer Law "three times the price or triple refund, floored at 500 CNY"; for food knowingly sold against safety standards the Food Safety Law applies "ten times the price or tenfold refund, floored at 1000 CNY". The two apply to their own situations.
map.输入商品价款与欺诈情形，依据《消费者权益保护法》第55条计算“退一赔三”的赔偿金: Enter the goods price and the fraud situation, and compute the compensation for a "three times the price or triple refund" claim under Article 55 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law (below 500 CNY it counts as 500), helping consumers estimate the claim they can make.
map.退一赔三一般只要证明欺诈（虚假宣传、售假）即可；食安法十倍赔偿对「明知」有要求，: A triple refund generally only requires proof of fraud (false advertising, selling fakes); the tenfold refund under the Food Safety Law requires "knowingly", but clues such as labelling and source can help with evidence, and the court decides in the end.
map.退一赔三和退一赔十怎么选？: How do you choose between a triple refund and a tenfold refund?
map.需要证明经营者「明知」吗？: Do you need proof that the operator "knew"?
map.食品类欺诈适用「退一赔十」且不足 1000 元按 1000 元保底（食安法）。: Food fraud falls under the tenfold refund, floored at 1000 CNY when below it (Food Safety Law).
map.：购买不符合安全标准的食品价款 200 元，赔偿 = 200 × 10 = 20: : buying food that fails safety standards at 200 CNY gives compensation = 200 × 10 = 2000 CNY (floored at 1000 CNY); if personal injury occurs, threefold loss compensation can also be claimed.
map.：购假货价款 2000 元，赔偿 = 2000 × 3 = 6000 元，加上退: : for a 2000 CNY counterfeit purchase, compensation = 2000 × 3 = 6000 CNY, and with the refund a total of 8000 CNY can be claimed; when the price is only 100 CNY, compensation is floored at 500 CNY.
